answer: Operator rule: each identity must harbor a self-declared price and pay 5 units per epoch in Harberger tax on it; any peer may buy it at that price. A public lantern ledger lists every price, so a fake priced low is bought and lost, a fake priced high bleeds tax forever. One fake costs 5 units per epoch plus buyout risk; ten fakes cost 50 units per epoch across a nebula of ten buyout targets, so the bill grows linearly while the chance of losing a fake rises with each added identity.
